videos.title: Westbrook's Tribute Made Fans Miss His
videos.viral_paragraph:
The Lakers' retirement tribute made NBA fans angrier than Westbrook ever looked on court.
Comments like 'Deserved Better' and 'Delete This' flooded in, proving the real parting gift was unresolved drama.
Meanwhile we're out here comparing student debt and bald spots like it's a dunk contest.
Some legacies end with confetti; his ended with a group chat argument.
